title: Product Owner
description:
Vaga: Product Owner (PO)


⸻


Sobre a posição


Buscamos um(a) Product Owner (PO) para atuar diretamente na evolução dos produtos da Wite, trabalhando em conjunto com times que utilizam Node.js, Next.js, APIs e arquiteturas modernas.


Essa posição tem papel fundamental na qualidade das entregas, sendo responsável por garantir que as demandas estejam bem analisadas, detalhadas, organizadas e quebradas em subtarefas claras, facilitando a execução do time de desenvolvimento.


Procuramos alguém com visão analítica, atenção a detalhes e capacidade de avaliar, otimizar e direcionar tarefas técnicas e funcionais, sempre alinhadas ao objetivo do produto.


É uma função prática, próxima do time técnico, com foco em execução, clareza, qualidade e redução de retrabalho.


⸻


Responsabilidades


Avaliar demandas de produto considerando o contexto técnico de aplicações em Node.js, Next.js e APIs.


Detalhar requisitos funcionais e técnicos de forma clara e objetiva.


Quebrar demandas maiores em subtarefas bem definidas, considerando backend, frontend e integrações.


Ajudar a direcionar o time técnico sobre o escopo correto e a ordem de execução das tarefas.


Organizar, atualizar e manter o backlog com alto nível de qualidade.


Apoiar o PM na priorização e refinamento das atividades.


Garantir que histórias estejam completas, claras e com critérios de aceite bem definidos.


Identificar inconsistências técnicas, riscos e pontos de melhoria antes da execução.


Acompanhar entregas para garantir aderência ao que foi definido.


Documentar regras de negócio, fluxos e decisões de produto.


Manter comunicação clara, organizada e objetiva com o time técnico e de produto.


⸻


Requisitos técnicos


Capacidade de analisar requisitos e transformá-los em histórias de usuário claras e executáveis.


Boa compreensão de aplicações web modernas baseadas em Node.js e Next.js.


Noção de funcionamento de APIs, integrações e fluxos backend e frontend.


Experiência prática com backlog, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceite.


Domínio de Jira ou ferramenta similar para organização e acompanhamento das atividades.


Capacidade de quebrar demandas técnicas e funcionais em subtarefas objetivas.


Boa organização e atenção a detalhes.


Vivência com produtos digitais e times de desenvolvimento.


⸻


Competências comportamentais


Perfil analítico e organizado.


Foco em qualidade e clareza.


Boa comunicação com times técnicos.


Proatividade para identificar melhorias e riscos.


Responsabilidade com entregas e escopo.


Postura colaborativa.


Capacidade de ouvir, analisar e direcionar.


⸻


Importante


Buscamos um PO técnico, organizado e detalhista, que entenda o contexto de Node.js, Next.js e APIs, e ajude o time a trabalhar com mais clareza, eficiência e qualidade.


Perfis superficiais ou pouco atentos a detalhes não atendem ao que buscamos.

title: Engenheiro de Software Pleno Mobile Flutter (PJ)
description:
O Grupo Smart Fit é muito mais do que a maior rede de academias da América Latina e o maior empregador de profissionais de educação física do mundo. Somos um verdadeiro ecossistema focado em bem-estar e saúde, impactando a vida de milhares de pessoas todos os dias.


Estamos em mais de 15 países, com mais de 1.800 unidades, e temos o prazer de atender mais de 5,2 milhões de alunos. Nossa equipe de 15 mil colaboradores está sempre a mil, trazendo novas ideias e inovações. Desde que abrimos nossa capital em 2021, aceleramos nossa missão de transformar vidas com soluções de fitness e saúde.


Temos várias marcas no nosso portfólio, como Bio Ritmo, Smart Fit, Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, One Pilates, Velocity, Kore TotalPass e Nation CT. Além disso, oferecemos produtos digitais como Queima Diária, Smart Fit Nutri e Smart Fit Coach. Estamos sempre procurando novas formas de integrar tecnologia e inovação para ajudar você a ter um estilo de vida mais ativo e saudável. E aí, topa o desafio junto com a gente?


O que nos move todos os dias?

Somos parte da mudança, transformando o cenário e trazendo mais qualidade para a vida de quem tá junto com a gente. Cada gotinha de suor é uma prova do nosso compromisso em inspirar e motivar todo mundo que quer uma vida mais ativa e saudável. A cada dia, começamos nossa jornada com aquecimento total, prontos para alcançar novos objetivos e viver o máximo.


O Engenheiro de Software Pleno Mobile Flutter (PJ) será responsável por:

1. Desenvolvimento e Entrega Contínua

  • Evolução do App: Desenvolver novas funcionalidades e componentes com foco em código limpo, testável e de fácil manutenção.
  • Ciclo de Releases Semanais: Garantir a entrega de incrementos de software funcionais e testados ao final de cada ciclo, respeitando os prazos das sprints.


2. Colaboração e Qualidade Técnica

  • Review de Código: Realizar revisões de código (Code Reviews) dos parceiros de equipe, garantindo a manutenção dos padrões técnicos, a disseminação de conhecimento e a qualidade da base de código.
  • Apoio à Liderança: Prestar suporte técnico ao Líder Técnico e ao Gerente de Produto na viabilidade de novas features, ajudando a quebrar requisitos complexos em tarefas técnicas menores e estimáveis.
  • Sintonia com Backend: Colaborar ativamente na definição e consumo dos endpoints, garantindo que a comunicação entre App e API seja performática e segura.


3. Sustentação e Suporte

  • Atendimento de Chamados: Atuar no suporte e resolução de chamados de nível técnico, identificando a causa raiz de bugs reportados e implementando correções definitivas.
  • Homologação e Testes: Testar e validar cada funcionalidade em múltiplos dispositivos, garantindo que a experiência do usuário seja consistente em Android e iOS.


4. Excelência em UI/UX e Performance

  • Garantia de Fidelidade Visual: Assegurar que o produto final seja uma cópia fiel do design proposto (Figma), mantendo a máxima qualidade estética e fluidez de navegação.
  • Otimização de Performance: Monitorar e melhorar constantemente a performance do aplicativo (tempo de resposta, consumo de bateria e memória).


5. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua

  • Evolução Técnica: Manter-se atualizado com as atualizações do ecossistema Flutter/Dart, aplicando melhorias que tornem o processo de desenvolvimento mais eficiente.
  • Mentalidade Proativa: Identificar antecipadamente riscos de integração ou atrasos, propondo soluções ao time para evitar retrabalhos ou bloqueios nas entregas semanais.


Itens essenciais que não podem faltar no seu kit:

  • Domínio de Flutter & Dart: Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de aplicações robustas para Android e iOS a partir de uma base de código única.
  • Fidelidade ao Layout (Pixel Perfect): Capacidade de transformar designs complexos (Figma) em interfaces funcionais com alta precisão, respeitando rigorosamente guias de estilo e componentes.
  • Consumo de APIs REST & Resiliência: Experiência avançada em integração com APIs, com tratamento de erros de rede, estados de loading/empty e estratégias de cache offline.
  • Gerenciamento de Estado Profissional: Domínio de soluções escaláveis como Bloc, Riverpod ou Provider, garantindo a separação clara entre lógica de negócio e UI.
  • Performance e Otimização: Habilidade em identificar e corrigir gargalos de performance (jank), otimização de imagens e gerenciamento eficiente de memória.
  • Testes e Qualidade: Experiência na escrita de testes unitários e de widgets para garantir a estabilidade das funcionalidades core durante as evoluções do app.
  • Pragmatismo e Foco em Valor: Mentalidade voltada para soluções que equilibram rapidez de entrega com robustez técnica, evitando complexidade desnecessária.
  • Comunicação Proativa e Colaboração: Trabalho em sintonia fina com o desenvolvedor Backend para alinhar contratos de API e evitar retrabalhos nas integrações.
  • Atenção aos Detalhes: Rigor visual e funcional; o aplicativo deve ser polido e fiel à identidade visual em diferentes tamanhos de tela.
  • Agilidade e Adaptabilidade: Capacidade de trabalhar com releases semanais, mantendo a cadência de entrega e a qualidade sem comprometer a estabilidade das versões anteriores.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Data & Security Engineer to build, maintain, and secure analytics infrastructure for a prediction market platform (Forkast). This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, on-chain analytics, and security, with a strong focus on trade activity analysis, dashboarding, and anomaly detection.

You will be responsible for transforming raw on-chain and off-chain data into actionable insights, powering Hex dashboards, Dune Analytics, and internal monitoring systems that support product decisions, risk management, and market integrity.


Responsibilities:


Data & Analytics

  • Design and maintain Hex dashboards for real-time and historical market insights.
  • Build and optimize Dune Analytics queries for on-chain trade activity, liquidity, user behavior, and market performance.
  • Analyze trade activity across prediction markets to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies.
  • Develop data pipelines to ingest, clean, and normalize blockchain and application-level data.
  • Support forecasting and prediction market analytics (volume, liquidity, pricing efficiency, trader behavior).


Security & Risk

  • Monitor markets for suspicious trading behavior, manipulation, wash trading, or oracle exploitation.
  • Build alerts and dashboards for risk and security events.
  • Collaborate with protocol and smart contract teams to assess data-related security risks.
  • Ensure data integrity, access control, and best practices for sensitive analytics infrastructure.


Prediction Market Intelligence

  • Support Forkast market design with data-driven insights.
  • Analyze market resolution accuracy, trader incentives, and pricing signals.
  • Create metrics to evaluate market health and predictive performance.


Requirements:


Technical Skills

  • Strong experience with SQL (especially for Dune Analytics).
  • Hands-on experience building Dashboards in Hex (or similar BI tools).
  • Familiarity with blockchain data (Ethereum or EVM chains preferred).
  • Experience analyzing on-chain trade activity and user behavior.
  • Solid understanding of data security principles and monitoring systems.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with prediction markets, DeFi, or financial markets.
  • Knowledge of smart contracts, oracles, and on-chain risk vectors.
  • Python or similar language for data processing and automation.
  • Experience with anomaly detection or fraud analysis.
  • Familiarity with Forkast or similar platforms (Polymarket, Kalshi, etc.).


What we are looking for?

  • Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail.
  • Ability to translate raw data into clear, decision-ready insights.
  • Security-conscious approach to data and infrastructure.
  • Comfortable working in fast-moving, crypto-native environments.
  • Proactive problem solver who can work independently.

﻿

Why Join Us?

  • Work on cutting-edge prediction market technology.
  • High ownership over data and security architecture.
  • Remote-friendly, flexible working environment.
  • Opportunity to shape market integrity and analytics at scale.

title: SAP Coupa Source to Pay
description:
Position Summary:

As part of Digital Core Transformation team, you will be responsible for the design and implementation of Coupa and surround system (SAP S4Hana) capabilities supporting Procurement business processes. We’re looking for someone who has experience supporting teams, project management, and values strong vendor partnerships. This is your opportunity to experience working cross-culturally in a global setup with peers, leaders & teams across geographies.

You will co-create with technology professionals in a unique environment that fosters and supports original thinking. You’ll drive digital solutions that better serve consumers, customers and employees. What’s more? You’ll be helping to create products that help individuals experience more of what’s important to them.


Responsibilities for this role include:

  • Lead Solutions Design for Coupa, Configuration, Documentation, Testing, and Delivery with intelligent automation (Scope includes work among SAP and non-SAP Systems and Applications)
  • Excellent technical & functional configuration knowledge and demonstrated proficiency for SAP Source to Pay, inclusive of Smart Contract Management, Spend Analytics, Guided Buying, and Collaborative Supply Chain & Procurement Materials Management, Materials Management (Direct and Indirect)
  • Participate in gathering and documenting overall business requirements. Support all formal documentation of implementation and provide relevant functional inputs to technical team.
  • Configure and implement Coupa solutions for source to pay processes. Should be able to perform global Coupa configuration, Approval Workflow, Custom field set up for transactions, Chart of account, PO forms, Catalog, Supplier, Item, User setup, Security Roles and Permission as per business requirement.
  • Experience in Coupa Configuration and data loads in Sourcing, Contracting, Purchasing, invoicing Master data(Supplier, Materials and Accounting data) and Catalog Management.
  • Experience with Coupa integration and mapping to legacy SAP systems for transactional and master data interface in source to pay.
  • Create functional specification documents that require development of WRICEF (Workflow Reports Interfaces Conversion Enhancement and Form) objects
  • Prepare test cases, validate deliverables, and support client testing and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Responsible for solving complex business problems by creating IT solutions in consultation with business partners, architects and other stakeholders
  • Operate in close partnership with the IT and business communities, subject matter experts, external consultants, cross functional teams, add-ons, etc.
  • Advise business partners on the implications of standard or new SAP solutions that can be applied to a problem.
  • Create and execute outcome-oriented strategies and build/sustain meaningful business relationships


Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 8-10 years IT experience – in End-user industry or IT consulting or Systems Integrators or with IT Product
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience working on procurement transformations at an enterprise scale
  • A degree in Engineering from a premier institution or Chartered Accountancy.
  • Post graduate diploma/ MBA with specialization in Finance and/or IT from a premier institution is preferred
  • Minimum of 7 years configuration experience in Coupa/SAP S4 HANA Source to Pay, Procurement, Materials Management
  • Experience in IT capabilities for other functional areas e.g. Supply Chain/ Logistics, Order-to-Cash, Finance will be desirable
  • Must have worked in configuration, testing, and implementation of Coupa.
  • Participated in multiple full cycle global SAP implementations, with a focus on analytics led business transformation
  • Experience in IT capabilities for other functional areas e.g. Supply Chain/ Logistics, Order-to-Cash, Procurement will be desirable
  • Coupa with SAP S/4 HANA global implementation experience or equivalent next generation business transformation implementation
  • High Learning Agility with outcome-oriented and a transformative mindset bringing forward best in class data, process, and technical designs for purpose
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills; must be a constructive challenger/assertive
  • Experience in creating/ reviewing functional specifications for custom enhancements
  • Ability to create and execute outcome-oriented strategies and build/sustain meaningful business relationships
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work effectively and collaboratively with internal business, technical, and external consulting teams
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to manage projects and teams including working with vendor partners
  • Experience to work in a global setup with peers, leaders & teams across geographies and ability to work in a cross-cultural context
  • Formal training & certification in SAP Functional modules is preferred


Comments for Suppliers:

Coupa certification is a must, along with SAP (functional) experience, not so much on the technical experience. Client is currently on Coupa R44.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.

Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become "super-users" of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum's capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum's strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.

Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.

Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a "process expert" within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.

Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.

Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.

Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.

Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.

Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum's coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.

Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.

HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum's Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you'll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.

We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.

Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

Fulkrum

title: Junior Recruiter
description:
Analista de Recrutamento Júnior - Híbrido (Rio de Janeiro, Brasil)

Esta função exige um mínimo de três dias por semana de trabalho presencial em nosso escritório no Rio de Janeiro.

Interviews will be conducted in English

Resumo da Função: Excelência em Recrutamento de Nível Concierge

Estamos buscando um Analista de Recrutamento Júnior para oferecer um serviço de recrutamento "white glove" e de nível concierge para nosso estimado cliente farmacêutico, com foco no mercado brasileiro. Esta função exige um indivíduo de natureza polida, orientado a processos e que possua uma forte mentalidade de serviço com habilidades de comunicação superiores e uma atenção aguçada aos detalhes.

Você será responsável por revisar proativamente os candidatos para determinar se eles atendem aos requisitos rigorosos e à experiência de trabalho para perfis farmacêuticos complexos, garantindo uma experiência premium, contínua e elevada para todos os candidatos e partes interessadas.

O Que Você Fará

A função principal desta posição é gerenciar o recrutamento de ciclo completo com a disciplina meticulosa exigida para perfis de indústria complexos (por exemplo, Produtos Farmacêuticos, Dispositivos Médicos, Aviação).

  • Engajamento de Candidatos e Gerentes de Contratação: Cultivar relacionamentos fortes, atuando como um concierge profissional para garantir uma experiência elevada durante todo o processo.
  • Revisão e Apresentação de Candidatos: Revisar, triar, pré-qualificar e apresentar talentos proativamente, incluindo a capacidade de desmembrar perfis complexos para uma busca eficaz e uma comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Liderança no Processo de Candidatura: Conduzir os candidatos pelas etapas iniciais do processo de candidatura com foco em velocidade, discrição e qualidade.
  • Conformidade de Processos e Administração de Sistemas: Garantir estabilidade em funções anteriores e gerenciar processos complexos com estrita aderência à conformidade do processo de recrutamento e à administração do Sistema de Rastreamento de Candidatos (ATS).
  • Colaborar em projetos especiais para aprimorar a estratégia e as operações de recrutamento.

O Que Você Precisa Trazer

Candidatos bem-sucedidos são definidos por sua estabilidade, comunicação e abordagem orientada a processos.

  • Experiência: Um mínimo de 1+ ano em uma função de suporte direto a funções de recrutamento e experiência comprovada em recrutamento de ciclo completo por pelo menos um ano.
  • Educação: Bacharelado ou atualmente matriculado para obter um.
  • Comunicação: Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e oral que refletem um profissionalismo de natureza polida.
  • Idiomas: Fluência em Português e Inglês é obrigatória para prospecção no Brasil e colaboração com partes interessadas internacionais. Espanhol é um diferencial.
  • Sistemas: Experiência comprovada com Sistema de Rastreamento de Candidatos (ATS) e um sólido entendimento de produtos MS Office/Google.
  • Mentalidade: Capacidade comprovada de trabalhar em um ambiente de equipe, aceitar direção e executar um plano, e possuir uma forte orientação para detalhes com acompanhamento demonstrada em empregos anteriores.

O Que Você Ganha

  • Junte-se a um líder de mercado global em serviços de RH com reconhecimento da indústria.
  • Junte-se a um local de trabalho diverso e inclusivo.
  • Acesse uma ampla gama de oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento.
  • Junte-se a uma empresa que oferece um ótimo equilíbrio entre vida profissional e pessoal.
  • Junte-se a uma empresa com processos comprovados e tecnologia de alta produção para criar eficiência.

As candidaturas serão aceitas continuamente até que a vaga seja preenchida.

Junior Recruitment Analyst - Hybrid (Rio de Janeiro, Brazil)

This role requires a minimum of three days per week on-site in our Rio de Janeiro office.

Role Summary: Concierge-Level Recruitment Excellence

We are seeking a Junior Recruitment Analyst to deliver "white glove," concierge-level recruitment service for our esteemed pharmaceutical client, focusing on the Brazilian market. This role demands an individual who is polished in nature, process-driven, and possesses a strong service mindset with superior communication skills and a keen attention to detail.

You are responsible for proactively reviewing candidates to determine if they meet the rigorous requirements and job experience for complex pharmaceutical profiles, ensuring a premium, seamless, and elevated experience for all candidates and stakeholders.

What You Get To Do

The core function of this role is to manage full-cycle recruitment with the meticulous discipline required for complex industry profiles (e.g., Pharmaceuticals, Medical Devices, Aviation).

  • Candidate and Hiring Manager Engagement: Cultivate strong relationships, acting as a professional concierge to ensure an elevated experience throughout the process.
  • Candidate Review & Presentation: Proactively review, screen, pre-qualify, and present talent, including the ability to break down complex profiles for effective searching and clear stakeholder communication.
  • Application Process Leadership: Lead candidates through the initial stages of the application process with a focus on speed, discretion, and quality.
  • Process Compliance & System Administration: Ensure stability in previous roles and manage complex processes with strict adherence to recruitment process compliance and Applicant Tracking System (ATS) administration.
  • Collaborate on special projects to enhance recruitment strategy and operations.

What You Need To Bring

Successful candidates are defined by their stability, communication, and process-driven approach.

  • Experience: A minimum of 1+ year in a role directly supporting recruiting functions and demonstrated full-cycle recruiting experience for at least one year.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree or currently enrolled to obtain one.
  • Communication: Excellent written and oral communication skills that reflect a polished in nature professionalism.
  • Languages: Fluency in both Portuguese and English is required for sourcing within Brazil and collaborating with international stakeholders. Spanish is a plus.
  • Systems: Demonstrated Applicant Tracking System (ATS) experience and a solid understanding of MS Office/Google products.
  • Mindset: Proven ability to work within a team environment, take direction and execute a plan, and possess a strong detail orientation with follow-through shown in previous jobs.

What's In It For You

  • Join a global market leader in HR services with industry recognition.
  • Join a diverse and inclusive workplace.
  • Access a wide range of learning and development opportunities.
  • Join a company that offers a great work/life balance.
  • Join a company with proven processes and high-output technology to create efficiency.

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until filled.

title: Ejecutivo/a de cuentas y operaciones Brazil
description:
Oportunidad profesional Latin Xplore Brasil !
Latin Xplore, agencia receptiva mayorista B2B y empresa hermana de Go West Tours (DMC USA), que tiene oficinas en Costa Rica, Panama, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Argentina, Brazil y Chile esta buscando su Ejecutivo de Cuentas y operaciones en nuestra oficina de Rio, Brasil.
Su misión va desde el establecimiento de itinerarios, la reelaboración de estos dentro de los presupuestos del cliente, la contratación, la facturación y la organización de los grupos y FITs, así como la asistencia en la organización de la A a la Z de los diferentes tours.
Puesto : Ejecutivo de Cuentas y Operaciones
Lugar: Bureau de Latin Xplore à Rio, Brasil
Descripción del Puesto
- Estar en contacto con los Tour Operadores, las agencias de viajes de Europa para responder a los pedidos de viajes y producciones para sus clientes
-Realizar cotizaciones de los viajes y elaboración de producciones
- Negociar con los proveedores para estar competitivos, mejorar las tarifas de compra y las márgenes, con la ayuda del Gerente General
-Desarrollar la facturación de la cartera de clientes: mantenimiento de relaciones con clientes existentes y desarollo con nuevos clientes, fidelizar, mantener el vínculo con las cuentas clave,
-Trabajo comercial con posible participación en ferias, seguimiento de los files, relanzas,
-Coordinación con de las operaciones. Cumplir, cuando sea necesario, con tareas de operación (reservar hoteles, guías, restaurantes, transfers, excursiones).
- Manejar las distintas herramientas de comercialización y trabajo : Travel Exchange, Toursys, Excel
Competencias Técnicas Requeridas:

  • Dominio Avanzado de Herramientas Informáticas: Excelente competencia en Microsoft Office, especialmente en Excel para cotizaciones, Word para la redacción de documentos. Canva sería una ventaja.
  • Experiencia Profesional en Turismo: Experiencia significativa en una agencia de viajes o en una agencia receptiva, con una comprensión profunda de las operaciones y la logística del turismo, así como del mercado B2B.
  • Conocimiento del Terreno de Brasil : Un conocimiento profundo de los principales destinos turísticos, las regulaciones locales y las particularidades culturales, lo cual es esencial para la elaboración de propuestas de viaje a medida. El conocimiento de otros países como Argentina puede ser también una ventaja.

Competencias sociales y personales:

  • Flexibilidad y adaptabilidad: Capacidad para adaptarse rápidamente a los cambios y gestionar eficazmente situaciones imprevistas, entusiasmo e inversión en una empresa en pleno crecimiento que coloca al ser humano en el centro de sus preocupaciones.
  • Multitarea y gestión de la presión: Capacidad para gestionar simultáneamente varios proyectos y clientes mientras se cumplen plazos ajustados, garantizando una prestación de servicio eficiente y profesional.
  • Competencias interpersonales y comunicación: Excelente habilidad para comunicarse, negociar y establecer relaciones duraderas con clientes y proveedores.
  • Orientación al cliente: Compromiso para proporcionar un servicio al cliente excepcional, anticipar las necesidades de los clientes y proponer soluciones creativas y adaptadas. Rigor y sentido del detalle son cualidades que buscamos para estar lo más alineados posible con las especificaciones de nuestros clientes y nuestra carta de calidad.

  • Un salario competitivo basado en la experiencia

  • Entorno de trabajo híbrido, combinando oficina y teletrabajo

title: Software Engineer, Brazil - X Delivery
description:
Locations : São Paulo | Rio de Janeiro
Who We Are
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
We Are BCG X
We're a diverse team of more than 3,000 tech experts united by a drive to make a difference. Working across industries and disciplines, we combine our experience and expertise to tackle the biggest challenges faced by society today. We go beyond what was once thought possible, creating new and innovative solutions to the world's most complex problems. Leveraging BCG's global network and partnerships with leading organizations, BCG X provides a stable ecosystem for talent to build game-changing businesses, products, and services from the ground up, all while growing their career. Together, we strive to create solutions that will positively impact the lives of millions.
What You'll Do
As a part of BCG's X Delivery team, you will play a pivotal role in bridging technology and strategy. You will collaborate with premier consulting teams around the world, applying your software development expertise across a variety of ambitious and ground-breaking international projects. You will be instrumental in advancing BCG's Consulting and BCG X teams by providing critical software development insights and speeding up project execution.
As a Software Engineer, your role involves close collaboration with consulting teams to address complex and diverse technological challenges. You will apply your expertise in software development methodologies to add value to BCG's Consulting & BCG X teams and Practice Areas.
Each project offers a unique opportunity to showcase your skills and make a significant impact within BCG and our esteemed clientele.
What You'll Bring
We are seeking technologically adept engineers who bring strong experience and diverse skills to our dynamic team. This role is an outstanding opportunity for someone who is passionate about software development and embraces opportunities to learn and make an impact in a fast-paced, innovative environment. If you're driven by technology and ready for impactful challenges, our BCG X Delivery team could be a great match!
Technical Skills - Knowledge and Experience with:
Coding Skills: Strong coding skills and proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, Kotlin, Node.js, Go, Ruby, Rust, C#, etc.. Experience with multiple languages preferred.
Web Development Expertise: Experience with Typescript or JavaScript frameworks such as React, Next.js, and Angular. Demonstrated projects or work experience are helpful.
API Development: Solid experience in creating APIs using REST or GraphQL.
Cloud Computing: Familiar with AWS, Azure, GCP, and capable of effective deployment on these platforms.
Database Management: Skilled in both relational and NoSQL databases, including MongoDB, Neo4j, and Redis.
Additional Skills:
Experience with Spark, Hadoop, or similar systems.
Practical knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, or similar technologies.
Familiarity with CI/CD tools like CircleCI, Jenkins, etc.
Tech curiosity with interest and exposure to technologies like AR/VR, IoT, AI, Blockchain.
Knowledge of infrastructure as code practices using Terraform, Chef, Puppet, or Ansible.
Job requirements:
Bachelor's / Master's in Computer Science or a related field
Fluency in Portuguese and English
Proven background in end-to-end application development, preferably in a commercial or consulting environment.
Active contributions to open-source projects or technical communities are highly valued.
Core Attributes:
Software Development: Demonstrated experience in developing, testing, and deploying robust software. Examples of past projects or contributions are advantageous.
Full Lifecycle Experience: Active involvement in the complete software development lifecycle, showcasing skills from idea generation to deployment.
Efficiency Optimization: Experience in optimizing software for performance and efficiency.
Dynamic Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, client-facing environment. Experience in client interactions for product development is a plus.
Collaborative Skills: A track record of working effectively in team settings, sharing ideas, and co-developing solutions.
Additional info
Please apply for the positions equivalent to your previous work experiences. The seniority will be evaluated according to your experience and career structure at BCG X during the process.
Even if you don't meet all these requirements, we encourage you to apply if this job description excites you.
Note: For this position, we are considering applicants from São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, including both the capital cities and the surrounding areas within a 150km radius of the capitals.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.


Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.


Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.


Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.


Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.


Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.


Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.


Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.


Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office;
    CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.


Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.


Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.


Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.


HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.


We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.


Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.


Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

Fulkrum

title: Ejecutivo/A De Cuentas Y Operaciones Brazil
description:
Oportunidad profesional Latin Xplore Brasil !
Latin Xplore, agencia receptiva mayorista B2B y empresa hermana de Go West Tours (DMC USA), que tiene oficinas en Costa Rica, Panama, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, Argentina, Brazil y Chile esta buscando su Ejecutivo de Cuentas y operaciones en nuestra oficina de Rio, Brasil.
Su misión va desde el establecimiento de itinerarios, la reelaboración de estos dentro de los presupuestos del cliente, la contratación, la facturación y la organización de los grupos y FITs, así como la asistencia en la organización de la A a la Z de los diferentes tours.
Puesto : Ejecutivo de Cuentas y Operaciones
Lugar: Bureau de Latin Xplore à Rio, Brasil
Descripción del Puesto
- Estar en contacto con los Tour Operadores, las agencias de viajes de Europa para responder a los pedidos de viajes y producciones para sus clientes
-Realizar cotizaciones de los viajes y elaboración de producciones
- Negociar con los proveedores para estar competitivos, mejorar las tarifas de compra y las márgenes, con la ayuda del Gerente General
-Desarrollar la facturación de la cartera de clientes: mantenimiento de relaciones con clientes existentes y desarollo con nuevos clientes, fidelizar, mantener el vínculo con las cuentas clave,
-Trabajo comercial con posible participación en ferias, seguimiento de los files, relanzas,
-Coordinación con de las operaciones. Cumplir, cuando sea necesario, con tareas de operación (reservar hoteles, guías, restaurantes, transfers, excursiones).
- Manejar las distintas herramientas de comercialización y trabajo : Travel Exchange, Toursys, Excel
Competencias Técnicas Requeridas:
 - Dominio Avanzado de Herramientas Informáticas: Excelente competencia en Microsoft Office, especialmente en Excel para cotizaciones, Word para la redacción de documentos. Canva sería una ventaja.
- Experiencia Profesional en Turismo: Experiencia significativa en una agencia de viajes o en una agencia receptiva, con una comprensión profunda de las operaciones y la logística del turismo, así como del mercado B2B.
- Conocimiento del Terreno de Brasil : Un conocimiento profundo de los principales destinos turísticos, las regulaciones locales y las particularidades culturales, lo cual es esencial para la elaboración de propuestas de viaje a medida. El conocimiento de otros países como Argentina puede ser también una ventaja.
Competencias sociales y personales:
 - Flexibilidad y adaptabilidad: Capacidad para adaptarse rápidamente a los cambios y gestionar eficazmente situaciones imprevistas, entusiasmo e inversión en una empresa en pleno crecimiento que coloca al ser humano en el centro de sus preocupaciones.
- Multitarea y gestión de la presión: Capacidad para gestionar simultáneamente varios proyectos y clientes mientras se cumplen plazos ajustados, garantizando una prestación de servicio eficiente y profesional.
- Competencias interpersonales y comunicación: Excelente habilidad para comunicarse, negociar y establecer relaciones duraderas con clientes y proveedores.
- Orientación al cliente: Compromiso para proporcionar un servicio al cliente excepcional, anticipar las necesidades de los clientes y proponer soluciones creativas y adaptadas. Rigor y sentido del detalle son cualidades que buscamos para estar lo más alineados posible con las especificaciones de nuestros clientes y nuestra carta de calidad.
Lo que ofrecemos:
 - Un salario competitivo basado en la experiencia
- Contrato local con beneficios complementarios
- Entorno de trabajo híbrido, combinando oficina y teletrabajo
- Participación en un proyecto innovador y en plena expansión, con un excelente ambiente de trabajo y posibilidades de crecimiento

title: Sondador
description:
Resumo da função:


Responsável por realizar operações de perfuração e/ou intervenções de poços (workover) operando sondas, sejam elas hidráulicas ou convencionais;
liderar as equipes em diversas atividades, com ou sem sonda, tais como: atividades Rig up/Rig & down (montagem e desmontagem), despressurização de poços, slick line, pescaria, wireline, dentre outras, visando pela segurança operacional, ambiental e da equipe.


Responsabilidades:

  • Conhecer e interpretar os principais dados específicos do poço (profundidade, pressão da formação, densidade do fluido de amortecimento, MAASP, etc), diagrama proposto de equipagem e o diagrama anterior para iniciar/dar continuidade as intervenções do tipo workover
  • Executar as atividades de assentamento de packer: mecânico e hidráulico, corte de cimento e tampões mecânicos (BPP e BPR) obedecendo e tendo conhecimento dos parâmetros necessários como peso sobre broca e circulação
  • Garantir a correta execução de atividades de equipagem com conjunto BCS obedecendo os cuidados necessários com a elevação das cargas para não ocorrer a flambagem, obedecendo os cuidados necessários com o manuseio e operação do cabo BCS, spooler, conectores elétricos (pig tail), instalação de clamps e alinhamento do orifício do PTS do suspensor com o adaptador A3EC
  • Executar inspeções nos equipamentos de manobra (colar de segurança, cunhas manuais e hidráulicas, elevadores de tubo, chave hidráulica) e de elevação (eslingas e cabos) bem como garantir sua integridade antes do início das operações
  • Realizar o check list diário de inspeção do sondador e garantir o correto preenchimento/inspeção dos demais check lists (torrista e plataformista) pela sua equipe orientando os demais sempre que necessário
  • Operar a sonda conhecendo os principais riscos inerentes ao tipo e a capacidade da sonda – em sonda convencional deve garantir a correta execução da tonelada milha
  • Executar e garantir a execução de todos os aspectos de segurança exigidos em atividades em área classificada, trabalho em altura, movimentação de cargas, testes hidrostáticos, H2S, equipamentos rotativos e segurança de poço
  • Planejar de forma antecipada todos os materiais e ferramentas necessários para a intervenção, bem como garantir a integridade dos equipamentos e ferramentas a bordo comunicando ao supervisor qualquer dano ocorrido
  • Garantir que a equipe siga rigorosamente o programa do poço atendendo todos os parâmetros exigidos bem como as normas vigentes de segurança operacional e de equipamentos de ESCP
  • Saber pesquisar e ter em mãos tabelas de cimentação, tabelas hidráulicas, manuais de perfurações, tabelas de tubos e revestimentos, etc.
  • Controlar todos os parâmetros operacionais do workover: peso sobre broca, densidade e viscosidade do fluido, vazão e pressão de bombeio


Exigências do Cargo:

  • Disponibilidade - Amplitude de horário – Plantão noturno - Trabalho Offshore 14x14
  • Experiência como Sondador de sondas tipo HH Drillmec e ou convencional à cabo 250.000lbs(tipo double joint/mesa rotativa) comprovados em carteira de trabalho;
  • Experiência comprovada em assentamento de tampões mecânicos e hidráulicos e obturadores (packers);
  • Experiência em equipagem de poço com coluna BCS;
  • Conhecimento teórico e prático na atividade de perfuração e/ou completação;


Escolaridade mínima:


  • Ensino médio técnico completo


Qualificação A: antes do embarque:


  • Curso Básico de Segurança de Plataforma - CBSP
  • Treinamento de Escape de Aeronave Submersa - HEUT
  • Well Control IWCF – Level 3
  • Programa de Capacitação em Segurança e Saúde no Trabalho - NR37 - Básico

title: Supervisor (A) Responsabilidade Social

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.


Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

  • Supervisionar procedimentos da pasta social do Programa Interage e gestão da legislação aplicável.
  • Monitorar o cumprimento da legislação de Responsabilidade Social.
  • Supervisionar a execução de projetos sociais e acompanhar projetos incentivados.
  • Direcionar atividades de relacionamento com populações em situação de vulnerabilidade.
  • Participar de processos de recrutamento e seleção da equipe, quando necessário.
  • Contribuir na definição de programas de treinamento e reciclagem profissional.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais solicitados pela gerência.
  • Garantir conservação e limpeza dos equipamentos de trabalho.
  • Cumprir normas e procedimentos internos.
  • Conduzir veículos utilizados nas atividades de forma segura.
  • Zelar pelo cumprimento das normas de saúde, segurança e uso adequado de EPIs.
  • Comprometer-se com as áreas de Gestão da Qualidade, Meio Ambiente e Segurança do Trabalho.

  • Formação: Ensino superior completo (preferencialmente em áreas relacionadas à Responsabilidade Social, Administração ou Gestão de Projetos).

Informações adicionais:

  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!


A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.


Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 22.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Contract Administrator
description:
Position: Contract Administrator

Location: Rio de Janeiro (Barra da Tijuca)


About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have been a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and sustainable value to our stakeholders around the world.


Responsibilities

Support the administration of contract management activities, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely execution of all contractual processes.

Draft, organize, and file contracts and amendments, maintaining structured and compliant documentation aligned with internal policies.

Monitor contract lifecycle deadlines, including renewals, expirations, and key deliverables, ensuring timely follow-up with relevant stakeholders.

Collect and prepare documentation required for contract formalization and perform initial reviews of standardized terms under the guidance of senior staff or the legal team.

Update and maintain contract management systems with accurate data, ensuring proper tracking, reporting, and documentation of all contract activities.

Follow up on approval workflows and digital signature processes to ensure internal governance compliance.

Provide administrative and cross-functional support to Legal, Procurement, Finance, and Operations teams, ensuring smooth process execution and efficient information flow.

Support audits, internal reviews, and documentation assessments related to contract governance, identifying opportunities for process improvements.


Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree in Law.

Previous experience in administrative, contract management, legal support, or documentation-related roles is preferred.

Intermediate English (Mandatory)

Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.

Solid communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams.

Familiarity with digital workflow platforms and contract management systems is an advantage.


Benefits

Meal and food allowances.

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay).

Life Insurance.

Annual Bonus.

Private Pension Plan.

Childcare Allowance.

One day per week of home office.


Note:

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC values diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds, including women, Black and Indigenous individuals, PCDs, and LGBTQIA+ people.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About You

You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.

You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you’re curious about AI/ML integrations even if you’re not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
  • Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
  • Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
  • Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
  • Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or similar.
  • Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
  • Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
  • Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
  • Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
  • Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
  • Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
  • Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
  • Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
  • Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.
  • (If senior/lead-leaning) Support or mentor less-experienced data engineers as the team grows.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Analista Fiscal Pleno
description:
Na SAAM Towage Brasil, estamos em busca de nosso(a) próximo(a) Analista Fiscal Pleno.


A pessoa será responsável por realizar a apuração de impostos indiretos, análise e conferência de documentos fiscais, elaboração e entrega de obrigações acessórias, assegurando conformidade com a legislação vigente.


Principais funções


  • Realizar a apuração de ICMS , devoluções e conferência de documentos fiscais;
  • Executar a apuração de PIS e COFINS não cumulativos , analisando créditos, bases de cálculo e ajustes conforme legislação vigente;
  • Preparar, validar e transmitir a EFD-Reinf , garantindo consistência das informações e integração com as demais obrigações;
  • Elaborar e validar a DCTFWeb , conferindo débitos, compensações e amarrações com a folha e demais módulos;
  • Acompanhar e entregar demais obrigações acessórias fiscais , como SPED Fiscal, EFD-Contribuições, GIA, Sintegra (quando aplicável), declarações municipais e estaduais;
  • Analisar notas fiscais de entrada e saída, verificando correta classificação fiscal, CST/CFOP, benefícios fiscais e enquadramentos;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, organizando documentações e respondendo questionamentos técnicos;
  • Monitorar alterações na legislação tributária e reportar impactos;
  • Auxiliar na melhoria de processos, automatizações, controles internos e padronizações do setor.


Requisitos ⚡


  • Formação acadêmica: Formação em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência: Experiência prévia em área fiscal , preferencialmente em empresas de médio ou grande porte;
  • Conhecimentos gerais:
  • Conhecimento sólido em ICMS , suas variações e desdobramentos interestaduais;
  • Domínio em PIS e COFINS não cumulativo , incluindo créditos permitidos e regras de apuração;
  • Experiência comEFD-Reinf e DCTFWeb (envio, conferência e fechamento);
  • Vivência com SPED Fiscal e EFD-Contribuições ;
  • Capacidade de interpretar legislação tributária e aplicar no dia a dia;
  • Emissão de DANFE (Importação e circulação de mercadorias)
  • Excel intermediário/avançado;
  • Desejável conhecimento em ERP (SAP Hana, Navision ou similar).


Condições ⚓


  • Local de trabalho: Centro - Rio de Janeiro
  • Horário: 9h às 18h (3 vezes presencial)
  • Tipo de contrato: Prazo indeterminado


Candidate-se e navegue rumo a novos desafios conosco!


Reforçamos que esta oportunidade está aberta para todos(as), incentivamos à inscrição de profissionais com deficiência (PCD).

title: Especialista De Ativo Fixo
description:
Sua missão como Especialista de Ativo Fixo será:


  • Atuar como autoridade técnica no controle da depreciação contábil e fiscal dos ativos fixos, garantindo o alinhamento com as normas contábeis (CPCs, IFRS) e políticas corporativas;


  • Realizar análises complexas sobre vida útil, valor residual, reavaliações, revisões de critérios e impactos financeiros de decisões de investimento em ativos;


  • Liderar o processo de teste de recuperabilidade (impairment) dos ativos, em conjunto com controladoria e planejamento financeiro;


  • Desenvolver e implementar melhorias e automatizações nos processos de controle de depreciação, conciliações e fechamento contábil de ativos;


  • Suportar e liderar projetos estratégicos relacionados à gestão patrimonial,reorganizações de ativos e mudanças em normas contábeis;


  • Atuar como ponto focal em auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo dados, explicações técnicas e coordenando a resolução de eventuais não conformidades;


  • Liderar os inventários físicos dos ativos fixos e propor os ajustes através das conciliações;


  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos, pareceres contábeis e apresentações executivas com análises de impactos e recomendações;


  • Realizar análises do imobilizado/intangível em andamento;


  • Participar do desenvolvimento e revisão da política contábil de ativos e manuais internos de capitalização e controle patrimonial;


  • Oferecer suporte técnico a outras áreas da empresa (Fiscal, Suprimentos, Jurídico), assegurando o correto tratamento de ativos em todo o seu ciclo de vida;


  • Elaborar e manter KPI`s relacionados aos temas de Ativo Fixo.


Por isso esperamos que você possua:


  • Ensino Superior em Ciências Contábeis, com CRC ativo;
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Domínio profundo das normas contábeis brasileiras e internacionais aplicáveis a ativos (CPC 27, CPC 01, CPC 46, IFRS 16, entre outras);
  • Forte conhecimento em depreciação contábil e fiscal, inclusive regimes especiais e impactos tributário;
  • Experiência comsistema ERP (SAP), com foco em módulos de ativo fixo;
  • Usuário avançado de ferramentas Excel e PowerBI;
  • Conhecimentos evivvência em processos de auditoria, compliance e controles internos (SOX, por exemplo);
  • Conhecimento e vivência de rotinas de utilização do ERP SAP no módulo de AA.


Ao embarcar na Omni você terá:

  • Vale-Refeição

  • Vale Combustível.

title: Analista De Negócios
description:
Requisitos


Profissional com experiência prática comprovada de, no mínimo, quatro anos atuando em projetos como Analista de Negócios, Analista de Requisitos ou Analista de Métricas de Software . Deve possuir conhecimento em medição de tamanho funcional de software na unidade de Pontos de Função , seguindo as diretrizes do Manual de Práticas de Contagem (CPM) do International Function Point Users Group (IFPUG) .


Atividades a Serem Exercidas

  • Análise e levantamento de requisitos , garantindo alinhamento com as necessidades do negócio.
  • Medição do tamanho funcional de software utilizando a metodologia de Pontos de Função , conforme diretrizes do IFPUG .
  • Definição e documentação de requisitos com base em boas práticas e frameworks reconhecidos.
  • Interação com stakeholders para garantir clareza e precisão na definição dos requisitos.
  • Apoio na priorização e refinamento do backlog , colaborando com Product Owners e equipes de desenvolvimento ágil.
  • Participação em cerimônias ágeis , como refinamento, planning e retrospectivas, promovendo alinhamento entre equipes.


Conhecimentos Técnicos Obrigatórios (Comprovação Necessária)

  • Certificações :
  • IREB / CPRE Advanced Level ou EXIN BCS Practitioner Certificate in Requirements Engineering .
  • Certified Function Points Specialist (CFPS) – IFPUG .


Conhecimentos Técnicos Desejáveis (declarados pelo profissional)

  • Certificações Ágeis :
  • Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) – Scrum Alliance .
  • Advanced Certified Scrum Product Owner (A-CSPO) – Scrum Alliance .
  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM) – Scrum Alliance ou Professional Scrum Master (PSM) – Scrum.Org .


Soft Skills (Destaque para habilidades estratégicas e analíticas)

  • Pensamento analítico : capacidade de decompor problemas complexos e transformar requisitos em especificações claras.
  • Forte atenção a detalhes : essencial para garantir precisão na medição de pontos de função e na documentação de requisitos.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva : habilidade de interagir com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Colaboração e trabalho em equipe : essencial para atuar junto a squads ágeis e stakeholders do negócio.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis : experiência em ambientes que utilizam Scrum e Kanban para gestão de projetos.
  • Foco na entrega de valor : capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos que impulsionem o produto.

title: Operations Director
description:

Our client is a well-established Hong Kong-based multinational trading group with expanding operations across South America. They are seeking a seasoned Trading Director to lead their mining and/or food commodities trading business in the region.

  • Lead business development and market expansion across South America (primarily Brazil, Argentina, and surrounding countries)
  • Build and maintain long-term strategic relationships with key customers, suppliers, and partners

  • Proficiency in Mandarin Chinese will be a significant advantage
  • Strong cross-cultural communication and leadership skills;
    comfortable operating in diverse international environments
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and deep understanding of cross-border trade regulations, logistics, and financing
  • Willingness to relocate long-term to Brazil or Argentina


What We Offer

  • Highly competitive consultancy package
  • Attractive performance-based bonuses tied to P&L results
  • Opportunity to play a pivotal leadership role in a fast-growing international trading house
  • Direct exposure to global markets and senior management in Asia
  • Dynamic, entrepreneurial environment with significant autonomy




We offer an exciting career opportunity to the successful candidate. Interested candidates should submit their detailed CV in English, including current and expected remuneration and availability. Please email to
